primaryTextRead.text: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
